62e95265c9fd030007268fb9: Touch and Go: Welcome to the New World...same as the Old World.  While the Turtles attempt to assess the damage around their lair, they find that adjusting to their post alien invasion lives might be harder than they thought.
Hunted: For a two ton reptile, Leatherhead actually makes the ideal houseguest; neat, tidy, always pays his rent on time … except for the fact that his temper is really out of control.
H.A.T.E.: Donatello, Michelangelo and Raphael come across a band of crazed, heavily armed, alien-hating Survivalists, bent upon delivering and detonating a thermo nuclear device in New York City.

Nobody's Fool: When Michelangelo and Leonardo are out getting a little night air, they cross paths with a caped crusader who ends up saving their lives. The Turtles soon learn that he's really a cop who is out to get the one man who ruined his career.
New Blood: The "savior" of New York City, Oroku Saki, has another face: the Shredder. The turtles stumble upon the Shredder's real reason for "helping" New York.

The Lesson: April asks the Turtles to help perfect her ninjitsu skills. But the Turtles are reluctant to do so and recount a story about how they once tried to take a "student" under their wing.  They just weren't prepared to be teachers.

The Darkness Within: When Angel's brother disappears in the Wall Street area, the turtles jump to help her. Turns out that, as a result of all the destruction from the invasion, an ancient horror has been stirred.

Mission of Gravity: The Shredder sends Stockman and Hun on a quest to retrieve an Antigravity Generator from the city of Beijing, which is still floating in the upper atmosphere, thanks to the Triceratons.

The Entity Below: The Entity and his kind are awakened through a rare planetary alignment, and, harnessing great power, they proceed to start shifting the tectonic plates in order to bring back their world.
Time Travails: The turtles get sucked into a time traveling adventure by the somewhat vapid but totally cute Renet, Apprentice Timestress.

Hun on the Run: Hun's always been loyal, but too many failures have tarnished his relationship with his master. But, when Karai is captured by Bishop, the Shredder gives Hun a mission in which he can redeem himself: save Karai and bring her back alive.
Reality Check: Ultimate Drako is back and he's causing all sorts of chaos with the Time Scepter. He's sent the four turtles spinning through time into alternate realities.

Across The Universe: Because of Ultimate Drako's machinations, Raphael finds himself in an alternate reality … of the Planet Racers.This right down Raphael's alley … until that alley turns into a dead end and he's heading right for it!

Same as it Never Was: Ultimate Drako's time manipulations have sent Donatello to an alternate reality … and it's not pretty. It's one possible future, a horrible nightmare. The Shredder is all powerful.
The Real World - Part 1: Ultimate Drako is causing trouble with the Time Scepter. He blasts Leonardo into another dimension … Usagi Yojimbo's dimension.

The Real World - Part 2: Leonardo and Usagi arrive in the Battle Nexus hoping for a way to reunite the four turtles and their master. But, they find the Battle Nexus under the control of the evil Ultimate Drako. Master Splinter is his prisoner.

Bishop's Gambit: Bishop is back and making his move. His research demands a mutated specimen closer to human … a rat: Master Splinter.  Bishop kidnaps Splinter and moves to finish the creation of his genetically enhanced super soldiers.

Exodus - Part 1: Splinter receives a vision of his Master Yoshi…and a mission. He must stop the Shredder.Time is running out. He doesn't know how to explain it to his sons, but they need no explanation.They're with their father to the bitter end.

Exodus - Part 2: The Shredder is leaving earth in spaceship of his own construction intent upon wreaking havoc on the Utroms and the galaxy. But, he's taken on some unwanted passengers and, they're not about to let the Shredder get away.

Cousin Sid: Casey and April bring the Turtles and Splinter to Casey's farmhouse to heal up from the beating they took in the final fight with the Shredder. But before they can start to recover, Casey's cousin Sid crashes the scene…

The People's Choice: Out camping for the night, the four turtles find themselves in the middle of an election. It's not any ordinary election. The two female candidates are from a distant planet where the political process is trial by combat.
Sons of the Silent Age: Taking a Huck Finn styled trip down a local river, the turtles, Casey and April discover a nuclear power plant … as well as mermen of Y'Lantias … the last of their kind.
Dragon's Brew: Hun's taking the Purple Dragons to new heights. He hijacks a top secret government shipment…one of Bishop's little surprises.

I, Monster: On a training exercise in an abandoned brick works in the boroughs, Casey Jones and our four turtles run afoul of a strange "man." This is the Rat King… and even though they don't know it, the turtles have met him before.
Grudge Match: Mikey's blowing off trainings more than ever; he's the BattleNexus Champion, after all!  Who needs training?

Wing and a Prayer: It's a bird! It's a plane!  Okay, it's this guy with angel wings, an Avian, named Raptarr who is after this other guy with metal wings, named Mephos, who wants to take over the Avians' flying city.
Bad Day: Everything goes from bad to worse for the turtles. Life spins out of control in a nightmare of horror and pain. Who is behind all this? How will it ever end? P.S. Your cat is …

Aliens Among Us: It looks as if Agent Bishop might find himself out of a job or at least out of funding. With the President in New York City, the turtles are out watching the motorcade when they find themselves right in the middle a new alien invasion!

Dragons Rising: Hun wasn't kidding.The Purple Dragons really are going places.They're fast becoming a world class crime organization.  But, Casey's still got a score to settle with Hun … big crime syndicate or no.
Still Nobody: A gang of young toughs, filling the void left by the rising Purple Dragons, is out to bash an old man to keep him from testifying against them.

All Hallows Thieves: It's Halloween and all the freaks are out … especially the King of Thieves. He manages to bring to life an old idol, which wreaks havoc upon the town with its legions of gremlins.

Samurai Tourist: Usagi and Gen come to New York for a visit with the turtles. Gen gets a little carried away by the bright lights and the big city and goes wandering off on his own. Bishop hears of another possible "alien" presence.

The Ancient One: It is time for Leonardo to move on. Splinter sends Leo to a new sensei … or rather, a very old sensei. The journey is long and perilous. Can Leonardo look into himself and find the right answers to his questions?

Scion of the Shredder: Hades hath no wrath like a scion scorned. Karai strikes with a vengeance. She physically invades the ultimate sanctuary! The lair! She crushes the turtles' home and nearly crushes the turtles scattering them across town.
Prodigal Son: Leonardo returns from his lessons with the Master Sage to find the lair destroyed and his family scattered across town … all by the hand of Karai.

Outbreak: Something is growing and spreading in the sewers and the waterways.The remnants of Bishop's 'aliens' have infected various animals, mutating them into horrible beasts ravenous for anything that gets in their way… including turtles.
The Trouble With Augie: April receives a message from her long, lost Uncle Augie … who's trapped in another dimension.

Insane in the Membrane: Stockman has finally reclaimed his humanity by cloning a body for himself. Now, he is human once more … until his body starts to deteriorate and the changes undermine his sanity.

Neste episódio, os amigos seguem nas férias organizadas por Sam. Todos os outros amigos chegam para as férias, e Camilla volta a conversar com o Will para tentar esquecer o Brandon.

Os amigos têm que lidar com a presença indesejável da Cara e os ânimos estão alterados conforme ela tenta se aproximar. Sam está insatisfeito com a postura da Juliette em querer passar todas as noites fora.
Neste episódio de Siesta Key os amigos seguem em suas férias na ilha reservada pelo Sam, mas o clima não é de descanso e alegria para todos.

Neste episódio de Siesta Key os amigos refletem sobre o desastre que foi a festa de lançamento do clipe do Brandon. Se não bastasse a Camilla jogando a Jordana na piscina, Juliette bebeu demais e bateu na Kelsey.
Neste episódio, os amigos já voltaram a Siesta Key e começam a retomar suas vidas. Kelsey está relutante em perdoar a agressão de Juliette. E o futuro dos eventos entre os amigos está em jogo.

O aniversário de um ano de relacionamento da Juliette e do Sam chega, ele dá a ela um presente especial e planeja convidá-la para morar com ele. Juliette decide ligar para Kelsey para tentar se desculpar.

Neste episódio, Cara descobre que o namorado da Amanda tem postado nudes em um site e Brandon conta a Jordana sobre o aborto da Camilla e a artista precisa tomar uma decisão sobre sua relação com ele.

Juliette decide ir morar com o Sam, e eles organizam um almoço com os pais dos dois. Ela organiza uma festa de lançamento para sua marca e convida a todos e manda um recado para Kelsey durante seu discurso.

Depois de um dia de aventuras no deserto do México, os amigos resolvem celebrar a sua última noite em Cabo em uma festa na praia. No cardápio: Sinais confusos, Narizes enxeridos e para sobremesa a culpa do Karma.
A viagem dos amigos da casa para Cabo chegou ao fim. Kortni procura uma forma de se desculpar com a Nilsa e os pais de Codi viajam para Panama City Beach para lhe fazer uma visita.

Codi se enche de coragem para tentar alguma coisa a mais com a Candace. Gus luta contra os sentimentos que foram despertados com a chegada dos Butts na casa. Em uma noite muito louca no Ms. Newby's, Kortni encontra um novo lance.

Aimee tem que lidar com as consequências das suas ações no Newby's. O relacionamento de Codi e Candace progride depois do encontro deles. As garotas fazem uma performance inesquecível para os rapazes.

A Nilsa descobre que um erro do seu passado pode entrar no seu caminho para assombrá-la novamente. Com a sua recente notoriedade, Aimee tá com medo de ser vista em público em PCB. Candace vai precisar ir embora da casa de praia mais cedo.

Nilsa tem que fazer malabarismo para lidar com a situação de ter dois ex na casa, e definitivamente, ela não está pronta para deixar nenhum dos dois livre. Aimee procura ajuda de uma advogado para lidar com a situação dos seus problemas.
Nova cidade, nova casa, novo drama. Metade da casa está namorando, mas uma primeira noite selvagem e louca em São Petersburgo parece mudar tudo isso.

Candace está chateada sobre a escolha de quartos e surta com Nilsa e com Aimee. A galera se reúne para dar a Aimee uma festa de formatura do curso de controle da raiva, e um deles é levado de ambulância.

Depois de brigar com Codi, Candace o convida para almoçar para definir o relacionamento deles. Kortni volta do hospital e se irrita com seus colegas de quarto por eles estarem fazendo muito barulho. A namorada do Gus se torna o assunto da conversa.
